description.value: Happy Day Inn is a hotel-motel hybrid in the heart of Burnaby, about 20 minutes from Downtown Vancouver, offering a range of room types from standard to suites, some with fully equipped kitchenettes. The property includes free secured parking, complimentary continental breakfast, a fitness room and sauna, and coin laundry. Its central location near multiple transit options makes it a practical base for exploring Vancouver and the Lower Mainland.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed amenity listings. Free Wi-Fi is confirmed both on the /amenities/ page ('Free Wi-Fi Internet') and by OSM tags (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no). Coin laundry is listed on the amenities page. No mention of bike storage, bike-specific procedures, drying areas, e-bike charging, or bike tools appears anywhere on the site, so those fields are null. Address, phone, and website all match between OSM and the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible hotel with a functioning website, confirmed address, and active booking system. A practical overnight stop for touring cyclists in Burnaby.

Laundry.detail: Coin Laundry listed on the /amenities/ page

wow_evidence: fitness room and sauna, coin laundry, and free secured parking confirmed on amenities page
